notes.title: [OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT] Road to Season 1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/fa308d8efd02ea30e0eef36eb72721b35cc2e322.png

Road to Season 1
Our next target on Roadmap is to release Season 1, as part of the making game available to the  wider audience. This is something we’re planning to achieve in the next three months. Below is a short roadmap outline of what to expect in the next three to four months: 


 Missions: We’re planning to finalize testing and proofing and releasing around 100+ missions and quests for you to enjoy.
 Seasons Duration: Each Season will last 4 months and will end with a full wipe and reset before the next Season starts.
 Free Accounts Upgrades: To say thank you to players who supported us on our journey to Season 1, we will UPGRADE all active game accounts (not banned or refunded) as following: 


 Accounts will be upgraded to the next Tier (For example, Standard Accounts will become Ghost Operator, No Man’s Land accounts will become Accession).
 Accession accounts will receive 2,500 A-Notes, effectively giving as much real money value as most people paid for those accounts in the first place.
 At Start of the Season 1, all active accounts that have been registered before the start of the Season 1 will get 7 days of PRIME account status.

What kind of content and new functionality of the game will be included in a Season 1
Two new maps
At the start of Season 1 we will release two new maps, both are medium to large size outdoor maps, we’re working on right now. Please expect to get a glimpse on those maps in early February, when we will be releasing initial information on the maps content. 

Community Events
Every few weeks we will launch a Community Event - mission that will require all players to participate for a common goal. Every time each individual player completes part of the common goal, he will receive a small Reward. As soon as the community as a whole group will complete Event’s goal everyone who has participated will receive an Ultimate Event reward. 

Season Pass
This is our own take on a battle pass with a few twists. First of all - you don’t need to buy anything or unlock any “premium tiers” for the rewards. Everything is unlockable by playing the game and available to every player. For doing your normal game activities such as surviving expeditions, leveling up, completing quests and missions you will earn Season Tokens. You will use those tokens to unlock rewards split among 20 “rewards cells”. Cells are connected to each other and to unlock Cell you will need to spend a certain amount of Tokens in bordering Cells. This way Season Pass allows you to concentrate on unlocking rewards that are important to you. Most rewards are purely cosmetic, but some will allow you to get experience faster, PRIME status, added Global Vault Slots, etc. 

Inter Season Storage Box
Basically think of it as a special secure container that is not wiped at the end of the Season. At the start of the season it doesn’t have any capacity, and by unlocking Season Pass rewards, you can unlock up to 100 slots. All items that you place there will not be wiped and will be sent to your Mailbox at Season Wipe. 

Boss Hunt
Each Season will introduce several new Bosses. We expect to have 6 Bosses for Season 1. Each of the bosses will require its own strategy to defeat - they will not be just a dumb bullet sponges. When you eliminate each Boss for the first time you will receive a “Contract Reward” - a set of cool cosmetic and gameplay items. Also, of course, each time you kill Boss everything you will loot from its body is yours - and they DO HAVE LOTS OF COOL STUFF!

Leaderboards
Each season comes with a set of Leaderboards, celebrating the top players. There’ll be several categories of Leaderboards tracking progress at different activities. We will have Global Leaderboards as well as regional ones (we have broken the world into following regions - The Americas, Europe, MENA / Africa, Asia / Oceania)

During the transition period, we will continue releasing updates to improve the game, fix bugs, make changes based on feedback and we'll be adding missions in batches monthly for you to have fun, test and provide feedback on Discord Server.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.6.8 - gunplay overhaul and Game Systems changes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/cdad5f360958d464a68f412e8fdf2bf135df2526.png

This update aims at bringing significant balancing changes and additions based on feedback.

New and updated features

Account Upgrades
Following your suggestions, we have added an ingame “store” that allows players to upgrade their game editions completely or partially, by purchasing extra global vault slots, Cosmetic Tickets without having to exit the game and access through the browser. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/1989092fd25527e1717c8447c6e97730e6f66790.png

Gear Buffs/Debuffs
We have now added some gear item that will have buffs and debuffs. For instance, heavier armors may cause you to be slower, while ergonomic backpacks will allow you to carry more weight without penalties based on its current content weight.

Healing UI Update
Based on your feedback, we've added a tooltip ribbon to the Health menu. When you hover over an injury, it will display the medications you have that can treat that specific injury. You can also instantly use the selected medicine from the tooltip.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/48620364ea284ef40d0a6567a202fb634f6a025c.png

Unlocking Gun Skins
All gun skins are now fully functional and can be unlocked in-game. You can unlock them by looting items from expeditions or completing missions and challenges.

New Cosmetic Items
We have added over 40 new cosmetic items and skin patterns to the game. We have also lowered the prices on some cosmetics, based on your feedback.


Balancing Changes

Gear, Meds and foods
We have made major changes to the meds system. 

 All meds now heal all injuries as soon as the progress on using them ends. Previously, it would take a few seconds to use it, then it would have an effect after some more few seconds, making it confusing and unclear to players when using them during battles
 Most meds have had their “delayed action” removed and consume-time adjusted accordingly.
 Food items on the other hand have been adjusted to always restore SOME health over time.
 This is all work in progress and we will continue balancing out these items and time values based on your feedback as we are marching towards a “stable release” of the game in 2025. 


Gunplay
We have made major changes to the way gunplay feels based on your feedback. 

 Recoil patterns and dynamics have been reworked in a major way. Overall, we aimed to keep guns feeling more or less authentic in comparison to what real world gun enthusiasts would expect from them, however we still wanted to make sure the gun feels “right” to the majority of gamers and what they are used to. Please give us feedback and tell us what you think of their current state!
 We are working on fixing multiple bugs related to muzzle flashes that have caused them to display brighter and larger than expected to players. The new updated muzzle flashes should now feel overwhelming and excessive anymore, but they should still feel balanced to make sure players use the proper muzzle devices based on their task in hand.


Map Changes

Port
The entrance to underground tunnels has been changed. Based on your feedback, we have redesigned the entrance to the underground tunnels making them easier to use and more streamlined for players to navigate naturally.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/38bcfdb5de1ca4b4d1a6908f376f942399bb6108.jpg


Quality of Life and General Fixes

General Bug Fixes
 Fixed a bug that would allow players to dupe ammo
 Fixed the bug that would cause expeditions to start with a fully dark screen for some players
 Fixed an issue that would make you still take damage while using tactical shields
 Fixed an issue that would allow you to get very high discounts on Vendors. 
 Fixed a bug that wouldn’t allow you to swap gear in slots if there was no empty space in your inventory (like changing backpacks, armors, etc…)

UI/UX fixes
 Improved the "USE ITEM" button effect
 Added more item tooltips showing the actual effects of the items
 Remaining buff effect time was displayed in total seconds. Changed to a more clear format
 Fixed the stats tooltip for negative effects. It was showing as zero
 Fixed the rarity color display when dragging and dropping items
 Gunsmith: Price was shown incorrectly and deducted from players incorrectly
 Missions: Expiration Timer has been added more clearly on the mission status
 Added more Tooltips for items to make them easier to understand

notes.title: Patch 0.3.6.7
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/aa6f182b1150145e744d004846e0ee83a76228e7.png

Hello everyone,

As you have noticed we released another patch today with many bug fixes and a lot of adjustments.
Here's a recap of the main changes we've made, including the Hotfix rolled out earlier this week: 

MAPS

Port
 Fixed missing loot spawns
 Fixed Office Building obstables
 Fixed most of the maps Obstacles
 Added more mobs (Grunts only) in patrols and single patrols (practice your takedowns)


Ozersk-3
 Fixed the loot around the Construction Yard
 Reworked the Underground Entrance (ADU)/Military Base and rebalanced the loot
 Fixed flying objects and bushes
 Reworked paths to fix colliisions and obstacles blocking it
 Mob respawn timer increased at the Military Base/Underground Entrance

GAMEPLAY

Meds
 Changed the use time on meds: Meds are not used instantly and they have a slight delay on effect removal, which is then instant. 
 Changed the meds to make them more unique: Meds now will only help with specific debuffs. For example, Tourniquet will only remove Heavy Bleeding, but not light bleeding and cut.
 Changed meds availability on Vendors: We have made adjustments on new design changes as to make it easier for players to be able to buy basic meds for any condition.


Attachments
 Rebalanced most attachments: This is a work in progress and we will keep refining this throughout the next patches.
 Fixed attachment spawns in the world: We have added more attachments to the lood, including more magazines for SMGs, Rifles and Handguns. 
 Added low profile Vintorez Rails Adapter.


Gunplay
Through your feedback on our Discord and on Steam, we have made some adjustments to gunplay in general to make it feel more natural. 
 Changed recoil patterns and gun handling: These changes aim to make all guns usage more comfortable and shooting to be more skill based and less random. The major change was on the gun control/recoil code that were tailored to replicate behavior of real world guns in the game. However we have noticed this does not necessarily work well in a videogame, making the gunplay mediocre for players actively playing the game and forcing them to choose gun categories based on that. So now we've made it so all guns feel better and the choice between gun categories becomes more of a situation/preference rather than a good/bad case. 

This is still work in progress, so we will continue refining it throughout the next patches.

Gear
 Changed vests values and stats: More plate-carriers have side slots, making side armor plates more useful in the game. 
 Improved item usage interface: We have made adjustments to it to make it less obstrusive. 
 Fixed display stats bugs: We had some bugs with items having incorrect/inacurate stats displayed and usage in the inventory. 


Gunsmith
 Fixed the calculation of weapon assembly cost: The cost will now make more mathematical sense. 
 Fixed UX bugs: This is the bug that was causing attachments to be lost in your inventory after using the Gunsmith. 


Inventory
 Fixed items color coding bugs: Those bugs caused items to be displayed on occasion the wrong rarity color after moving it somewhere.


BUG FIXES
 Fixed the issue that caused mobs to spawn right in front of the players
 Added a timer for each mission
 Fixed the possible issue that would cause the black screen after joining expeditions
 Added the ability to remove food buffs
 Weapon crafting does not take existing attachments from the player's inventory
 Fixed Eye for an Eye mission bug
 Fixed quick slots visual bug that was caused by interrupting item usage
 Fixed the issue causing you to lose control of your character after using an item
 Removed the ability to switch secure containers while not in the Social Hub. You can only change it while in the Social Hub. 
 Fixed Badger-4 Ammo Name

notes.title: L33T - Quality of life and UX overhaul and improvements
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/aa0da7082b54a3c89db3ad7c083e293dddf29ffc.png

Since our last patch we've made hundreds of improvements to the game. Here are some major UI/UX changes we have made to improve overall Quality of Life for players. 


UI / UX / QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGES


 The item tooltip now shows the approximate value of the item for selling. That should make it easier for you to decide if you want to keep it or not.

 Ammo for the selected gun is now highlighted in your Inventory Slot, making it easier and faster to find the appropriate ammo. 

 Items have different colors based on rarity/value, but without making it too colorful. 

 Keybind/controls helper is displayed in strategic moments. They can also be disabled completely through the Options. 

 HUD is now highly customizable, giving you the ability to toggle different parts of the UI.

 Character statistics and statuses are more clearly displayed in different interfaces/screens, making it easier for players to evaluate character conditions and what to do about it.

 Added a “Pickup everything” and “drop everything from the backpack” actions to the Inventory.

 “Quick Sale” option from your inventory and backpack is now active, which should save you time when trading with NPCs.

 Ammo now show which armor level they will penetrate in a clear way, alongside the traditional penetration value. 

 Quick Heal menu has been added, making it possible for you to configure it to your liking and set up specific medications with a single hotkey. 

 Quick Select wheel menu has been added, which you can select grenades and medication for quick use. 

 Added an automatic sorting and stacking system for ammo.

 Added a function to place “minimap navigation points” in the HUD view without having to open the map interface. Just aim where you want to set it and use the hotkey. 

 If you don’t have ammo for a specific gun you choose for the raid, the game will ask if you want to equip the ammo. 

 Improved interface for healing and eating. It doesn’t fully block your screen anymore and players are able to WALK (you still can’t run, jump, duck, etc..) while using items. 

 Improved the gun disassembly interface. It shows you in more detail what you will get. 

 Leaning (left and right) - Animations have been reworked and it is now less pronounced and smoother, allowing you to use it more tactically.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.6.6 - Game Overhaul and New Maps
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/ef97421ee17b496c2e757d3bb92a9d491716cc57.png

Greetings everyone,

As you were aware, we have been working on a major overhaul for the game, on all game systems based on feedback received from Early Access players and now are ready to launch Season 1 of the game, making it available to a larger audience. 

Below is a recap of everything that’s been changed and what is available today in our first major patch.

PvE GAME MODE
By popular demand we have created a PvE-only Mode, which is included for FREE for all players who have purchased Project L33T. 

The PvE Mode concept is pretty clear - Play the game exclusively in PvE mode alone or in coop where you can take your time to learn and not go through the stress of playing online against people who may have more experience in the game genre/gaming in general. 

For those who are interested, we will also be offering Private Server rental for the PvE Game Mode allowing you further tweak game parameters and server settings and install server mods. 

Another significant difference between PvE and PvPvE modes is that you will have a separate character for this game mode, with their own Global Vault and Character Progression. 

For the new players who are interested in the PvE version of the game only and have not purchased Project L33T, the PvE Version of Project L33T will be available at a low price (US$9.99 - prices may vary per region), with its own separate Game SKU available on Steam in December. 

And for those who have purchased the Accession Edition of Project L33T, you will receive 4 complementary game keys for the PvE Version to give out to friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/3db844347e2f0fde48e6f68d8a1d346efa3b2411.png

REDESIGNED MEDICAL SYSTEM
As we have previously announced and shown sneak peaks on Discord, we have redesigned the medical system, along with the buff system to make it more user friendly and easier to understand and navigate through, but without throwing it all the way to the “Arcady” side. 

Now meds clearly show what they heal and their purpose and medical conditions also have a more profound and clear effect, which will be much more practical to understand. 

SECURED CONTAINER REDESIGN
Another system that has been redesigned based on feedback is the Secure Container System, here’s a quick breakdown of the changes. 

Secure Containers are not represented by physical items anymore, but rather unlocked through mission completions, challenges, as well as game account upgrades. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/ce745f31d2f036a478a0c2def7b859dad3f68e1e.png

NEW MAPS AND LOCALES

We will also be bringing some major changes to the first main map, along with new maps. Here’s a breakdown of them.

Ozersk-3
The map has been expanded by around 40% of its previous area and we have redesigned it based on feedback from the community and data we have gathered through our analytics. More spawns and more extraction points have been added and Points of Interest have been moved around the map to improve game flow. OZERSK-3 will also have the first Project L33T boss.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/2598b0a4102c128c92167a6547ad223c0e987dbb.png

NEW:  Port Vzmor'e Terminal
One of the new maps. A small-sized PvP-oriented map. It is perfect for direct gunfights in close combat, pushing and surprising enemies at every corner. This map will be available on this patch. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/87b35c8080bd514492434d46dea3f949219ae760.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/adcd4e578555f484059c9c029bc51b0421078cfc.png

UPCOMING: Minotaur
An upcoming Close Quarters Battle indoor map set in an underground military facility. This is a very unique map that will also be accessible through a special portal located within OZERSK-3. This map offers a nice blend of PvE and PvP fights and high value loot. EXPECTED FOR WINTER 2025.

UPCOMING: Overseer
With a classic “Claustrophobic” huge city feel, this is an urban map inspired by Hong Kong and set as a background for the deep space expiration radar arrays, it’s a mix of indoor and outdoor locations, creating the perfect blend of PvE and PvP with new corners for you to discover every game session. EXPECTED FOR Q1 2025.

UPCOMING: Cosmodrome
Another open landscape map, set in a “starbase” - a spaceship launch facility style of environment. With little vegetation to use as cover, this map is the greatest example of high risk, high reward loot experience. The PvE aspects of this map is also something to look for as it will bring high level PMC enemies to make it extra challenging. 

Big open spaces and vertical structures (including a spaceship launch pad), which will offer great sniping opportunities. This map will introduce another Game Boss - A skilled Sniper. EXPECTED Q1 2025.


MAJOR PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS
As we noticed from your feedback, performance was an important issue to be dealt with primarily with this patch, to make sure the game does not require only high-end computer setups to be played. 
Alongside general optimizations done to the code and all the content, we are now bringing new features that will also allow you to get much better performance and better frame rate.



GLOBAL ILLUMINATION QUALITY SETTING
This feature to increase performance for the game is the Global Illumination Quality settings - You will be able to choose between FIDELITY and PERFORMANCE modes, where FIDELITY leaves the illumination very realistic and PERFORMANCE improving your performance between 2-4 times), with higher frame rate, at the expense of overall graphics quality.

High Performance/Low Fidelity Lighting
This new settings option uses a lower-quality lighting system, providing the best possible performance and frame rate, but sacrificing the overall lighting quality and details. While the differences in the quality might not be blatant in outdoor environments, it will be very apparent indoors in comparison to the FIDELITY settings option. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/7be8380a635c118dbb011a4f13b2d572190a4ec8.png

High Quality Lighting
This setting will use Lumen, a state-of-the-art lighting system that delivers a very realistic lighting, reflections and shadows, creating stunning and immersive environments. However, this comes at a cost: Lumen is a very resource-demanding system, which may result in lower performance and/or reduced frame rates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/e8ca9bec1d9977513936e21686d97cfec3b80ce8.png




GUN OPTICS RENDERING OPTION
Another topic that came from feedback was the gun optics. We have separated it into two different modes.

Simplified
Simplified mode will use a simple zoomed-in view which will support a faster gameplay by rendering only the field of view of the scope, blocking out the surrounding areas. This method demands less on hardware and prioritizes precision and reaction time, making it ideal for fast-paced actions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/de217009f222eeb15f0554a4b1c6230d35a5db83.png


Realistic (Dual-rendering system)
This mode provides a much more realistic and tactical experience by preserving peripheral vision while aiming down sights (ADS). That means the field of view inside the score is zoomed while the area outside it remains unzoomed, mimicking real-life optics. This method, however, is more demanding on hardware as it requires the rendering of two different views simultaneously and can significantly impact your frame rate.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/180efca888d12e77a42a4afff9d490b47387d1b0.png




NEW: SHOOTING RANGE
The Shooting Range has been redesigned to allow you to try any types of ammo and guns, with all possible attachments, regardless of you owning them. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/0af7c1f60ee77dd0914371a07b720c39dc371241.png

It will also feature a “smart dummy”, which will allow you to gear them up with armor so you can test the difference in damage against armored and unarmored enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/0ff517ab7dcb9b3820d6c7ac4bb82806e2ece13f.png


HUD and MINIMAP
We have redesigned how information is presented to your teammates in your HUD, adding more information to the minimap, like active mission objectives, extraction points, etc…)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/60455b5db022d94bb211c3e0b0e9472572dd62e4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/121563fee7926454209e85dd1aa12c847f3cb6d6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/4e040bd951e932a9fcc5870d2dcf2eca5cabda52.png


NEW: SKILLS SYSTEM
On this patch, we will be introducing the initial version of the skills system. More skills will be added over time as well as rebalancing of these will be done throughout the season based on feedback.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/a8f2abe0861463167ad0b584fd8773c2153a5bda.png


NEW: GUNSMITH
A major new feature is the Gunsmith. It is a feature which will allow players to use the services of the Gunsmith to craft their own guns. He will charge you a fee for assembling the gun for you and some of these guns will require “Forge Tokens”, a special currency that can ONLY be obtained in the world or received as rewards for completing missions and challenges.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/79b934b30eb80163fdcb65467d25413f70316807.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/c65f73cf443a5e9f3282b9facaad70d86c31f0ae.png


AI OVERHAUL

We’ve made significant updates to the AI systems, making mobs more "lifelike" and smarter. Below are some of the improvements introduced in the new patch:
[olist]
Mobs Spawning and Behavior
Mobs now spawn inside apartments and other buildings behind closed doors. They will actively search through closed rooms and apartments, making it more challenging for players to evade them by simply hiding in a room and closing the door.

Redesigned "Senses"
The AI's sensory systems have been redesigned to feel more realistic. Mobs now react to various natural events and demonstrate more "natural" responses to players' actions, enhancing their lifelike behavior.

Improved Teamwork
The AI now functions better as a team, providing cover for one another, flanking players strategically, and using flashbangs and fragmentation grenades more effectively.
[/olist]

These changes aim to create a more immersive and challenging gameplay experience.

notes.title: Upcoming August Update - New Map: Port
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
 
Today I would like to bring you guys a sneak peak at our upcoming map, Port.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/342de51aa5a3ca0355cf939e6ef83f3a766d0124.png
 
Located in the southern part of the region, the Port map is a compact and intense battlefield designed for Close-Quarter Combat and fast-paced PvP scenarios. Once a bustling hub facilitating sea transportation between Ozersk-3 and other regions of the country, it has now been transformed into a clandestine base of operations. Mercenaries and smugglers have taken over the area, using it to transport weapons in and smuggle goods out. The tight corridors and narrow alleyways between containers of the Port provide a perfect setting for high-stakes confrontations and rapid engagements, making it an adrenaline-fueled experience for players.

This map is coming in early August!

notes.title: Project L33T - Update 0.4.1.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/54c8a232a8a61f29104fca4bdb2487c9d4442a7c.png

With the new Early Access release, we have made major changes from a technical perspective to improve performance, quality of life and easier understanding of the features. 
Here's a quick list of changes that went live on the release. 

CHANGES & FIXES

 Fixed most crashes we received reports from on Discord and directly through the Crash Report. 
 Reworked the economy and the Vendors prices.
 Fixed issues related to to attachments being read as invalid in some cases.
 Fixed animation with attachments on bottom rail
 Reworked the time for foods and buffs and displayed it more clearly
 Reworked the low poly model for the players.
 Fixed map collisions and reworked the the navigation.
 Fixed the bugs that grenades could be thrown through some walls.
 Fixed the revive distance for mercenaries

notes.title: Project L33T - Development Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/0fc42112c0d6d36803e2b279d0a4e24921b330aa.png

Hey everyone,

We are here just to give the community an update on the progress, plans and a review of all that should be expected until the end of the month of July.

STEAM RELEASE

We will be officially be launching on Steam on July 25th! So get ready for our release and pay close attention to the following information about it!

Pre-Order Access

If you have made a pre-purchase for the game through our website, you will receive a key on July 22nd (Monday) throughout the day to be activated on Steam! So keep an eye on the email you used on your purchase for further instructions!
Remember, this is an automated process, so emails will be delivered throughout the day, so don't panic if someone you know has received their key before you!

Twitch Drops

Our release will also come with a Twitch Drops campaign with cosmetic items for everyone who wants to Stream the game. Just make sure you stream under our game's category!
To receive the Twitch Drops, you will need to watch the streams for some time (TBD).
During this period, we will also be handing out on a random basis free keys of the game for you to play or gift to a friend if you have already pre-purchased!

Server Shutdown

On July 22nd, we will be shutting down the servers to prepare their infrastructure for the release! To keep up with everything, join our Discord HERE.
The servers will remain unavailable throughout the week.

Pre-purchase Discounts

The Pre-Purchase discount is still and will remain available until near our release date, so if you are planning to pre-purchase, don't risk it!

With that in mind, we are pushing back patches and updates to the current build, except gamebreaking bug and map fixes, but rest assure, our development team is working hard on those updates!

Once again, the Project L33T Team thanks all the players who have helped us throughout this pre-Alpha phases and appreciate all the feedback, criticism and interaction!

notes.title: Quality of Life Improvements Breakdown
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/8afac1bed3fef0fb251c0f66bef4b81f9ba7c721.png

In our most recent patch we have made some important improvements to players' Quality of Life.

These changes were mostly done through collecting feedback from our Discord, which can be found here: discord.gg/l33tgame

Quality of Life Improvements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/0809f348a02a899ca29b87cafec9d5ec4dfb2ce9.png
 You can now see an estimated value of the items looted in their pop-up descriptions (when you hover your mouse over their icons). This aims to help you figure out which items to extract with. 
 More stastistics have been added to the inventory and the Health Stats Screen. You can now see immediate effects on movement speed, hearing, stamina and injuries from consumable items and equipped gear.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/eb41447006426de2234c61b8642c82768036361b.png
 When hovering your mouse over a weapon in the inventory screen, ammo in your backpack and global vault will be highlighted. That should speed up the process of gearing up and choosing which ammo to pick up from bodies. 
 Added an "Unload Everything" option to the inventory screen. This allows you to quickly transfer items from your backpack to your Global Vault. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/09108d7a3c5067212cc8643e1064e45c3d459a06.png
 Added a "Sell" button from the context menu (right-click on the item).  
 Ammo now explicitly informs you what level of armor it can penetrate, that way it's easier to understand and faster to choose.
Added a visual display on how many repair kits will be used when dragging them over the item you want to repair. 


Keep up with our latest news and join our Discord Server now!

notes.title: Project L33T - Update 0.3.3.8
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/04939c7ddd95efbd91ee4fa0764a9c40cb691f16.png
Here are the latest patch notes.

Patch Highlights


 We've eliminated most of the crashes reported prior to the patch. Most of the ones remaining are related to known issues with Unreal Engine and Nvidia drivers that both Nvidia and Epic are aware of and affect many other running the engine. More details on bugs and fixes below.
 Our Anticheat systems (all three layers) have been fully activated with all features and we are in the process of tweaking paraments to exclude any false-positives. 
 We understand that being kicked out of the game for no reason sucks, but we are making sure that we eliminate those false-positives are cleared out while also keeping cheaters at bay. 
 The personal Homebase meta gameplay is close to being ready to be launched. More information on this later. 
 Full Missions journal has been enabled in game, which allows you to take on multiple missions, track progress and so on. 
 Gun skins painting kits have been added as part of the loot in the world. That means you will be able to unlock gun skins from items found in game. 
 Added new vendors and made changes to the way you unlock them. We have also added more items for them to sell and to barter. 
 You can now access the Black market vendor ZOTOV, who will exclusively trade with G. Coins. G. Coins are an exclusive ingame currency that you can acquire by finding them in the world, completing missions for Zotov or selling items to Zotov. 
 You can also now skip Marauder Expedition Cooldown using the G. Coin currency. 


World Map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/239dc138941b5584b34a99ec67d13d6adc431085.png

 Added a map selection screen. It shows all the maps we have currently planned for releases in 2024-2025. 
 Some of these maps are connected to each other, which will allow players to navigate freely between them without requiring an extraction or loading into the Social Hub from the Prologue map when they are released. This intend to bring in a bigger Open-World feeling to the game. 


Map Expansion

Unlocked more floors in the Ozersk-3 City Hall. 
A new area will soon replace the "Construction Yard", adding a Close-Quarters Battle maze to a half-finished office building.

Extraction Improvements
Added more extraction points to the map. More will continue to come, with random locations. 
Every extraction point is now clearly marked on the map along information on them, including requirements and if they are unlocked/available or not. 
Some of the afore mentioned Extraction Points will require an extraction fee in Dollars or G. Coins or specific item(s).

Quality of Life improvements

You can now see an estimated value of the items looted in the popup description (hover your mouse over the item icon). This aims to help you figure out which items you should extract with or not. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/294b873c34a1d72e741c3c76664f399e667e157c.png
Added extra statistics to the inventory and the Health Stats screen. You will be able to see immediate effect on your movement speed, hearing, stamina, etc from consumable items like meds, stimulants, food/drinks and equipped gear. 
When hovring over a weapon in the inventory screen, ammo from your backpack/inventory will be highlighted on your screen. That should speed up the process of gearing up and choosing which items to abandon in a raid. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/4c7d0f2b8c593955b7b110e2cd7c610d290bf98f.png
Added a "Unload everything" option to the inventory screen. This allows you quickly transfer all items from your backpack to your Global Vault. 
Added a "Sell to Vendor" button to the context menu (right-click on the item icon). 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44947709/d43b2cee3f3e6f09a32382e1941f493149e52b8e.png
Ammo now clearly shows what level of armor it penetrates for an easier and faster understanding. 
Added a visual display on how many repair kits will be needed/used when dragging them over the item you need to repair.
Added a quick heal button that automatically selects and applies meds to heal the first ailment in a list (This one is a bit confusing. Needs to be cleared out). 
Added a quick selection for grenades to equip or meds to use (default hotkeys are G and V, respectively)
Consuming meds or food/drinks now closes your inventory and lets you see your surroundings better (decreased the blur effect there).


Please continue giving your feedback on the feedback channel on Discord. 

Bug Fixes
Here's a list of soime of the bug fixes for this patch. Please continue reporting them to the bug-reports channel on Discord. 

General Environment improvements (lighting, bush/leaves density, etc...)
Improved performance (or loss of) when zooming in with a scope or binoculars. 
Added a visual effect on the timer when the raid is close to ending. 
Adjusted the volume of ambient sounds. Please let us know how they feel now. 
Added collisions around apartments to prevent players from climbing the roofs they shouldn't be accessing. 
Fixed a bug where players were able to use more slots than the limit of the container. 
Fixed a bug where players would see a double notification when using a key. 
Fixed a bug where players could drop secure containers. Now you are only able to move the container to your stash or container slots. 
Fixed a bug that made long descriptions cause issues in the UI
Fixed a bug where NPCs could shoot you without reloading. 
Fixed a bug that caused the MP9 to show the wrong caliber after being equipped to the weapon slot
Fixed a bug where knocking down your friends would count as a player kill
Fixed a bug where Experience was being granted when you killed your mercenaries. 
Fixed a bug where you weren't able to loot bodies that touched water
Fixed a bug with the Rifle Flashlight and Laser being turned off when switching guns. They will remain at the state they previously were.
Fixed a bug on the FAL Socom where leaning or aiming was not working properly.
Fixed several issues related to the Anticheat which caused players to receive a False-positive Cheat Detected Message
Fixed cliffs that didn't have proper collisions. 
Fixed several localization issues where names were not showing properly. 
Fixed a bug where the name of the caliber for the weapon was not showing
Fixed a bug where players could be damaged after being extracted
Fixed a bug where mission items were not being removed after abandoning a mission. 
Fixed a bug where the Rifle Flashlight was attached incorrectly
Fixed a bug where the item requirement on the UI were displayed incorrectly. 
Fixed a bug where the extraction point was showing the incorrect position on the minimap
Fixed a bug where multiple faceshields used the same vision (this is not clear)
Fixed a bug where marauder runs proceeded into weekly missions
Fixed a bug where your weapon would get stuck in the reload animation
Fixed a bug that caused you to be unable to hire mercenaries

Fixed a bug where picking up an item did not count for the misison goal
Fixed a bug causing GPU hang when opening inventory

notes.title: Project L33T - 0.3.3.6 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915131/04939c7ddd95efbd91ee4fa0764a9c40cb691f16.png

Project L33T has received a new update that adds a new big feature and a lot of bug fixes including adjustments.


Patch Highlights

We've been implementing our new Anti-Cheat Easy Anti-Chat to the game. This will help us fight against forbidden programs and make it fair for everyone.
It's an early state meaning disconnects or false messages could occur. If this is happening, please make sure you report it through our Discord server. We will be able to set everything correctly with your feedback and make the feature as good as possible.


Bug Fixes

Adjusted the opening sound of your inventory
Fixed 2 bugs that were caused by climbing up with your friend
Disabled the nearby alias feature during the raid
Fixed a bug where you couldn't close a menu if you assigned a different hotkey
Fixed some misplaced icons
Fixed a bug where armors with internal plates had infinite durability, now 0 means no protection
Fixed the reload animation of the 1911
Added the missing progress bar of weight in the customization menu
Fixed some exploits where players were able to remove parts of the environment
Added more guns to the Shooting Range
Fixed some tattoo cosmetics
Fixed a lot of missing names, descriptions, and icons
Environmental improvements
Added a reporting system
Fixed the stims advanced case
Items in the stash are getting stacked properly now
Fixed a bug where it was not possible to move a craft material from the backpack to the stash
Fixed some positions of crates that were spawning outside of the playable area
Fixed the notifications after using a key, it wasn't showing properly before
Fixed a bug where you saw a part of the Ghillie Suit while aiming


First of all, big thanks for all the reports and feedback, this helps a lot. Keep going!

Are you interested in bringing up reports, feedback, and discussions with the staff team? Join our discord server discord.gg/l33tgame
